extract: Registry default enabled accepts both ARM-scoped and ACR-scoped Entra authentication. Disabled accepts only ACR-scoped authentication. Some Azure services/integrations may fail with ACR-only configuration; compatibility must be tested. ACR-scoped login uses az login --scope https://containerregistry.azure.net/.default.
limitations: Documentation evidence only. No Azure authorization or live operation tested.
